description: The 9 groundable NamedEntity types + their KB anchors, copied verbatim from _EVAL-METHOD.md §2's ontology table. Each type is pinned to a KB target and (where the table spells one out) a Wikidata P31/P279 anchor so 'is this a place-entity?' is decidable, not vibes (the ad-freiburg type-whitelist approach). This is a reference table, not a validated schema; authority tokens are normalized to the `grounding.authority` casing used elsewhere (musicbrainz, google_places, wikidata, openlibrary). `wikidata_anchor` is null where the source table gives no explicit anchor. `restaurant` is NOT a type — it is absorbed into `place` as a facet/subtype (the place/restaurant split is exactly what broke the retracted matcher).

types.notes: built. Use AcoustID/Chromaprint audio fingerprint when the song is the audio — never gold-label from a title string
absorbs 'restaurant' as a facet/subtype — the place/restaurant split is exactly what broke the retracted matcher
carries TMDB/IMDb/Letterboxd as link-outs (no TMDB API)
notable products only; high legitimate-NIL rate — that's fine, NIL is a valid gold answer
